title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 2 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt:
The tables below give information about sales of Fairtrade*-labelled coffee and bananas in 1999 and 2004 in five European countries.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
scenario: The tables below give information about sales of Fairtrade*-labelled coffee and bananas in 1999 and 2004 in five European countries.

visualData.title: Sales of Fairtrade-labelled coffee and bananas (1999 & 2004)
notes: * Fairtrade: a category of products for which farmers from developing countries have been paid an officially agreed fair price.
